item.title: Ethicon, LLC: ETHILON Nylon Suture, Product Code 697G Recall
item.summary: Nylon suture indicated for use in general soft tissue approximation and/or ligation may have needles with distorted curvature, that may break during use, or could cause additional soft tissue or vessel injury, including tearing or bleeding intraoperatively. Product details: ETHILON Nylon Suture, Product Code 697G
item.affectedPeople: International distribution to the countries of JP, CA, AU.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
